remarks: Location and Space - have it all. This meticulously cared for ranch in the heart of Cranbury is ready for you. Living space galore this home is an entertainer's dream. Welcoming sundrenched formal living room with hardwood floors boosts a gas fireplace, formal dining room with wet bar and spacious eating space grants you all the space you'll need to host for the holidays. Cozy family room with amazing sunlight and French door access to the maintenance-free composite deck. Eat-in kitchen with new SS appliances. 3 Bedrooms all with hardwood floors down a hallway gives you the perfect separation from your living spaces. One full bath, One half bath. Laundry located in basement. BONUS SPACE: Work from home? At home Gym? The extra space with separate access gives you the flexibility you've been looking for. NEW Oil Boiler, NEW Hot Water Heater. This home is located in a prime location, huge deck, large storage shed, large yard. Convenient to everything. Agent is related to owner. Offers are due by Monday, July 29th at 5pm
